comments.author: @BeyondTheMapTV1
comments.text: One of the most interesting things about daily life in Israel is how time itself changes depending on community, religion and city. 🕯🇮🇱 A Friday afternoon in Jerusalem can transform streets and markets within minutes, while other neighborhoods continue almost normally. That coexistence of different weekly rhythms in such a small geographical area says a lot about how layered everyday life there really is.

comments.author: @nationscapefilms
comments.text: In Israel the week ends Friday afternoon and starts Sunday morning. Jerusalem's deadline is 40 minutes before sunset; Tel Aviv's is 18. Which city's version of a weekend would you last longer in?
